problem:
Find the characteristic equation of the matrix 
$D=[\begin{aligned}5 & -5 \\ 4 & -7\end{aligned}].$
worked_solution:
First, we find the matrix $\,D-\lambda I:$
﻿﻿﻿

$$
D-\lambda I=[\begin{aligned}5-\lambda  & -5 \\ 4 & -7-\lambda \end{aligned}].
$$

Then, the characteristic equation is 

$$
\begin{aligned}det(D-\lambda I) & =0 \\ |\begin{aligned}5-\lambda  & -5 \\ 4 & -7-\lambda \end{aligned}| & =0 \\ (5-\lambda )(-7-\lambda )-(-5)\cdot 4 & =0 \\ -35-5\lambda +7\lambda +{\lambda }^{2}+20 & =0 \\ {\lambda }^{2}+2\lambda -15 & =0.\end{aligned}
$$
